calls.title: Scott / Ashley 1:1
calls.summary: The team is preparing for Ryan's departure in two weeks, with Scott stepping in to take over his responsibilities. Key points of discussion include the need for Scott to engage with the Slack community and address gaps in documentation, particularly regarding data pipelines and debugging. Curriculum development is another focus, with Scott iterating on an existing document to separate feature flag basics from advanced topics, ensuring a progressive disclosure approach. The team is also advancing external marketing strategies, particularly through SEO-driven content and competitive positioning against companies like Optimizely. Moreover, GrowthBook's product release cycle, occurring every two months, was addressed alongside the need for improved visibility and documentation within product management. Continuous learning for Scott and plans for regular check-ins were discussed to enhance team collaboration.
calls.keywords: Feature Flags, Curriculum Development, Product Marketing, Release Management, Community Engagement, Personas
